title: Senior Implementation Consultant – EHR / EMR / HIS
description:
📍 India | UK business hours

🧠 Typically 3–8 years’ relevant experience

📅 Notice periods up to 45 days welcome

🚀 Bring your EHR expertise to the next generation of private healthcare

You know how healthcare software works. You can understand a customer’s workflows, design the right configuration, explain the product confidently and take an implementation through to go-live.

Now imagine owning that entire journey—and remaining the person the customer trusts as their business grows.

Script Assist is hiring a
**Senior Implementation Consultant**
with experience implementing, configuring and optimising Electronic Health Record (EHR), Electronic Medical Record (EMR), Electronic Patient Record (EPR) or Hospital Information System (HIS / HMIS) platforms.

We are particularly interested in professionals with experience across Oracle Health / Cerner, eClinicalWorks, Altera / Allscripts, Epic, NextGen Healthcare, InterSystems TrakCare, MEDITECH, athenahealth, Dedalus or comparable healthcare software.

You may currently work at an EHR vendor, a healthcare technology company, or within the healthcare technology consulting teams of PwC, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, Accenture, Cognizant, Infosys, TCS, Wipro, HCLTech or CitiusTech.

If you built your product expertise at an EHR vendor and subsequently moved into healthcare technology consulting, we would particularly like to hear from you.

**🏥 About Script Assist**

Script Assist is building the technology and operating infrastructure behind next-generation private healthcare in the UK.

Our platform already supports tens of thousands of prescriptions every month, with established scale in medical cannabis and expansion into ADHD, weight management, longevity and specialist private medicine.

We bring together the workflows that clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators need to run their services:

• Patient onboarding and patient portals

• Clinical consultations and scheduling

• Prescribing and repeat prescriptions

• Pharmacy, dispensing and inventory

• Payments and operational workflows

• Patient communications, reporting and integrations

Every customer operates differently. Your role is to understand those differences, design the right solution and help each customer get the best from Script Assist.

You will work directly with UK healthcare customers and closely with our leadership, Product and Engineering teams—with real influence over customer delivery and product development.

**🎯 The opportunity**

You will become a product expert and trusted client lead for UK clinics, pharmacies and healthcare operators.

You will understand their operations, design their workflows, configure their solution, demonstrate the product, train their teams and guide them through implementation.

After go-live, you will retain ownership of the relationship, helping customers resolve problems, improve adoption and develop how they use the platform.

The role brings together:

• EHR implementation and functional consulting

• Clinical and operational workflow design

• Application configuration and solution design

• Client workshops, product demonstrations and training

• UAT, go-live and post-implementation optimisation

• Ongoing client ownership and stakeholder management

**⚙️ What you will own**

Workflow discovery and functional solution design

• Lead client discovery sessions and requirements workshops.

• Map clinical and operational processes into clear system workflows.

• Translate requirements into configuration decisions, functional specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Advise customers on how to use the product effectively.

• Identify dependencies, explain trade-offs and challenge requirements constructively.

EHR application configuration

• Configure or lead the configuration of modules, forms, clinical templates, user roles, permissions, rules and system settings.

• Understand how configuration decisions affect the wider patient, clinician and pharmacy journey.

• Work across registration, appointments, clinical documentation, prescribing, medication management, work queues, patient portals and payments.

• Identify which requirements can be met through configuration and which need integration or product development.

Implementation and go-live

• Own customer delivery from discovery and solution design through configuration, testing, training and go-live.

• Coordinate data migration, integrations and customer dependencies with specialist teams.

• Lead UAT preparation, issue resolution and go-live readiness.

• Deliver product demonstrations, workflow walkthroughs and user training.

• Manage hypercare and the transition into ongoing platform use.

Client consulting and relationship ownership

• Lead meetings with clinicians, operational managers and senior healthcare stakeholders.

• Explain system behaviour and recommendations clearly and confidently.

• Manage expectations, priorities, actions and escalations.

• Maintain a detailed understanding of each customer’s workflows, configuration and objectives.

• Build lasting relationships through product knowledge, sound judgement and reliable follow-through.

Post-implementation optimisation

• Remain directly involved after go-live.

• Improve adoption, workflows, configuration and user confidence.

• Diagnose issues involving permissions, data, configuration, training, integrations or software behaviour.

• Translate product gaps into clear requirements for Product and Engineering.

• Validate fixes and follow issues through to resolution.

**✅ The experience we are looking for**

• Typically 3–8 years of relevant EHR, EMR, EPR, HIS or clinical information systems experience. Strong candidates outside this range are welcome.

• Deep functional knowledge of at least one substantial healthcare software platform.

• Personal involvement in system configuration or detailed configuration design.

• Experience delivering implementations or substantial optimisation projects for external healthcare customers.

• Direct responsibility for client workshops, requirements discussions, training or implementation decisions.

• Confidence investigating application and workflow problems.

• Experience collaborating with Product, Engineering, QA and Support.

• Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to independently lead senior UK client conversations.

• A hands-on approach and enthusiasm for learning a complex healthcare product.

**🔎 Relevant platforms and backgrounds**

We welcome experience with:

• Oracle Health / Cerner Millennium

• eClinicalWorks / eCW

• Altera Digital Health / Allscripts, including Sunrise and TouchWorks

• Veradigm

• Epic

• NextGen Healthcare / NextGen Enterprise

• InterSystems TrakCare

• MEDITECH / Expanse

• athenahealth / athenaOne

• Dedalus

• PracticeSuite, MicroMD, Napier, Ohum and other substantial EHR / EMR / HIS platforms

Relevant functional experience may include ambulatory care, outpatient workflows, patient administration, scheduling, clinical documentation, electronic prescribing, medication management, pharmacy, patient engagement and practice management.

Experience working with US, UK or other international healthcare customers is particularly valuable.

Relevant current or previous roles

Your title may be:

• Implementation Consultant / Senior Implementation Consultant

• Functional Consultant / Senior Functional Consultant

• Clinical Consultant / Clinical Applications Consultant

• Application Consultant / Application Specialist

• Delivery Consultant / Senior Associate Delivery Consultant

• EMR Consultant / EHR Consultant

• Clinical Information System Consultant

• Implementation Project Manager / EMR Project Manager

• Post Implementation Project Manager

• Implementation Manager / Client Onboarding Manager

• Product Specialist / Solution Consultant

• Healthcare Technology Consultant / Senior Associate

Candidates in EHR product ownership, business analysis or strategic client delivery are also welcome where their experience includes substantial configuration knowledge and personal implementation responsibility.

**🌟 Why join Script Assist?**

• Own the customer journey from initial requirements to long-term platform success.

• Apply your EHR expertise across a growing range of private healthcare services.

• Work directly with UK healthcare customers and senior decision-makers.

• Stay close to the product, with direct access to Product, Engineering and leadership.

• See your recommendations become working solutions used by real healthcare teams.

• Help shape both customer delivery and the platform itself.

**📍 Location, working hours and joining**

• Based in India.

• Available Monday–Friday, 09:00–18:00 UK time, including a one-hour break.

• UK summer hours: 13:30–22:30 IST.

• UK winter hours: 14:30–23:30 IST.

• Candidates able to join within 45 days are welcome.

**Interested?**

Please ensure your CV clearly identifies the EHR platforms and modules you have worked with, your personal configuration responsibilities, and the client implementations or optimisation projects you have owned.

We would love to hear how you could bring that expertise to Script Assist.

The role requires strong expertise in NetSuite financials, inventory, procurement, order management, and distribution workflows. The ideal candidate will drive solution design, validate business processes, maintain financial controls, and ensure a scalable, reliable ERP environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**NetSuite implementation and solution ownership**

* Participate directly in solution design, configuration, prototyping, testing, deployment, hypercare, and stabilization.
* Learn and document company's current processes, legacy applications, business rules, controls, data structures, and operational dependencies before replacing or redesigning them.
* Translate business requirements into practical NetSuite designs that favor standard functionality when it meets the business need.
* Review partner-proposed designs, identify gaps and downstream consequences, and challenge recommendations that create avoidable complexity, weak controls, or poor operational outcomes.
* Own material application design decisions and maintain functional architecture, configuration, decision, and support documentation.

**Financial management and controls**

* Support the design and configuration of general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash management, bank reconciliation, intercompany activity, financial dimensions, allocations, fixed assets, and period close
* Understand and validate the accounting consequences of transaction design across sales, purchasing, inventory, fulfillment, billing, returns, credits, and adjustments
* Protect subledger-to-general-ledger integrity through reconciliations, conversion validation, controlled posting logic, and clear exception handling.
* Partner with Finance to establish approvals, role permissions, audit trails, segregation of duties, and other control requirements.
* Validate financial reporting outputs and ensure configuration supports accurate, explainable, and repeatable close processes.

**Order to cash and customer operations**

* Design and support customer master data, sales orders, pricing, allocations, fulfillment, invoicing, payments, returns, credits, and related workflows.
* Support both owned-inventory and drop-ship transaction models, including customer-specific item references and order requirements.
* Evaluate the effect of design choices on customer service, warehouse execution, fulfillment accuracy, margin, and accounting.
* Work with process owners to define exceptions, approvals, controls, and measurable acceptance criteria for end-to-end customer transactions.

**Procure to pay inventory and warehouse processes**

* Design and support vendor master data, purchasing, purchase orders, receiving, vendor bills, matching, landed cost, payments, and returns.
* Support item master design, units of measure, locations, lot traceability, transfers, adjustments, cycle counts, costing, and inventory reconciliation.
* Address food-distribution requirements such as master case and break pack, assemblies, repack, catch weight, lot control, and related accounting flows when applicable.
* Confirm that application design works in the operating environment and does not shift hidden effort or control risk into warehouse, procurement, customer service, or Finance teams.

**Configuration administration and release governance**

* Configure or oversee roles, permissions, forms, fields, workflows, saved searches, dashboards, approval processes, and application preferences.
* Establish standards for configuration, customization, SuiteFlow, SuiteScript, naming, documentation, and environment management.
* Evaluate native functionality before approving extensions and ensure each customization has a clear owner, business purpose, test plan, and support approach.
* Maintain disciplined development, test, sandbox, and production practices with documented change control and release procedures.
* Support production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and manage an enhancement backlog based on business value, control risk, and operational need.

**Master data testing and cutover**

* Help define customer, vendor, item, pricing, chart-of-accounts, location, and other master-data structures, ownership, approval rights, and system-of-record boundaries.
* Participate in data mapping, cleansing, conversion, validation, and reconciliation with clear acceptance criteria.
* Develop and execute end-to-end test scenarios covering normal transactions, exceptions, integrations, financial posting, operational handoffs, and reporting.
* Take an active role in conference-room pilots, system and integration testing, user acceptance testing, cutover rehearsals, go-live readiness, and hypercare.
* Reject incomplete testing or unresolved defects that could compromise financial integrity, inventory accuracy, customer service, or operational continuity.

**Long term platform ownership**

* Become a primary internal owner and subject-matter expert for the NetSuite application environment.
* Build sufficient internal knowledge to reduce unnecessary dependence on outside consultants while using specialized partners where they add value.
* Maintain current documentation, operating procedures, configuration standards, training materials, and decision history.
* Evaluate new capabilities and enhancements against business value, total cost, control implications, operational impact, and supportability.
* Help establish a scalable ERP operating model that can support organic growth, new operating requirements, and future acquisitions.

**Qualifications:**

* More than 7 years of ERP implementation, enterprise applications, or ERP administration experience, including at least five years of meaningful hands-on NetSuite experience.
* Participation in at least one full-cycle NetSuite implementation with direct responsibility for design, configuration, testing, conversion, cutover, or stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of NetSuite financials and core ERP capabilities, including general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable, order management, purchasing, and inventory.
* Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, inventory accounting, financial controls, reconciliations, and subledger-to-general-ledger integrity.
* Demonstrated ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into practical, supportable system designs.
* Hands-on experience with roles, permissions, workflows, saved searches, reporting, master data, data conversion, and test execution.
* Ability to assess operational impacts and work effectively with Finance, procurement, operations, warehouse, customer service, and technology teams.

 The Odoo Developer will be responsible for developing, customizing, integrating, and maintaining Odoo\-based applications and business solutions. The role involves working across standard Odoo functionality and custom development to deliver scalable solutions aligned with business requirements.
 



  





 The position requires a combination of technical Odoo expertise, problem\-solving ability, understanding of business workflows, and strong software development practices.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Odoo applications and modules based on defined business and technical requirements.
* Analyze requirements and determine the appropriate approach using standard Odoo functionality, configuration, customization, or new development.
* Develop scalable and maintainable custom modules while following Odoo development and coding standards.
* Configure and automate business workflows, approvals, notifications, scheduled activities, and repetitive processes within Odoo.
* Develop and maintain API integrations and data synchronization between Odoo and third\-party applications.
* Develop custom reports, dashboards, analytical views, and business intelligence outputs based on operational requirements.
* Support Odoo version upgrades, including migration and compatibility of custom modules and integrations.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts, Project Managers, Solution Architects, QA teams, and other developers to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.
* Prepare technical approaches, estimates, development plans, and low\-level technical requirements where required.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools where appropriate to improve development productivity, debugging, testing, documentation, and code quality.
* Provide technical support for deployed Odoo solutions and ensure issues are analyzed and resolved within defined timelines.
* Contribute to the continuous improvement of Odoo products, solutions, development processes, and delivery practices.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong proficiency in Python and object\-oriented programming concepts.
* Strong understanding of the Odoo framework, architecture, ORM, models, domains, contexts, actions, and module structure.
* Hands\-on experience developing and customizing Odoo modules.
* Good understanding of Odoo core data models and standard functionality across areas such as CRM, Sales, Purchase, Accounting, Inventory, Projects, Timesheets, HR, and Helpdesk.
* Experience in extending standard Odoo modules using inheritance and custom business logic.
* Experience developing custom models, fields, workflows, wizards, server actions, scheduled actions, automated actions, and business rules.
* Strong experience with XML and Odoo view customization, including Form, List/Tree, Kanban, Search, Pivot, Graph, and QWeb views.
* Working knowledge of JavaScript and Odoo frontend framework for UI and functional customizations.
* Good knowledge of PostgreSQL, relational database concepts, and SQL queries.
* Strong understanding of Odoo security, including users, groups, access control lists, record rules, and role\-based permissions.
* Experience configuring and developing business workflows and process automation across Odoo.
* Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML, webhooks, authentication, and third\-party API integrations.
* Ability to develop or consume APIs for integration with external applications, platforms, and services.
* Experience developing custom dashboards, analytical views, KPIs, and management reports.
* Good debugging and troubleshooting skills across Python, XML, JavaScript, ORM, database, and integration layers.
* Knowledge of Git and source code management, including branching, merging, code reviews, and maintaining development standards.
* Understanding of application performance optimization, database optimization, and scalable Odoo development practices.
* Familiarity with Docker/containerized environments and Odoo deployment processes is an advantage.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding tools and LLM\-based development workflows for coding, debugging, documentation, testing, and productivity is a plus.

title: Senior Golang Engineer - Observability Preferred
description:
**Role \- Senior Golang Engineer \- Observability Preferred** 




**Experience: 3\+ Years** 




**Location: Ahmedabad** 




  





**Position Overview:** 




  





 We are looking for a systems\-minded developer with 3–5 years of hands\-on experience who is comfortable
 



 working close to the machine in Go/Rust, and equally comfortable reasoning about distributed behavior
 



 across a cloud\-native deployment. The ideal candidate has worked in the observability domain — metrics,
 



 logs, traces, time\-series storage and enjoys owning a module end to end. This is a high\-ownership role in a
 



 small, fast\-moving team. You will work across multiple modules, make design calls, use AI\-assisted
 



 development as a daily tool, and be accountable for what you ship in production.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibility:** 




  





**•** 
 Build and scale services for operational data ingestion, enrichment, storage, and query in a
 



 multitenant SaaS environment — spanning push\-based telemetry (metrics, logs, traces), polland protocol\-based collection (SNMP, WMI, SSH, ICMP), event streams (traps, syslog, flow), and
 



 discovery and inventory data.
 



 • Work with event/message\-driven pipelines (NATS) and time\-series, relational, and cache
 



 stores.
 



 • Design ingestion paths that handle heterogeneous sources and cadences — high\-volume
 



 streaming, scheduled polling cycles, bursty event traffic, and transactional API writes — each
 



 with different latency, ordering, and backpressure characteristics.
 



 • Normalize collected data into a common internal model, applying OpenTelemetry semantic
 



 conventions where they fit and defining consistent conventions where they don't, so
 



 downstream consumers see one shape regardless of source.
 



 • Build the data substrate for anomaly and signal detection — streaming aggregation, rollingwindow state, baselining, and correlation across metrics, logs, and traces — and integrate
 



 model inference into the ingestion and query path within latency and resource budgets.
 



 Own system design for your modules — write and defend design notes covering data
 



 model, interfaces, scaling limits, failure modes, and rollback.
 



 • Debug production problems end to end — reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix issues
 



 including performance regressions and platform\-specific behavior.
 



 • Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as part of the normal development loop,
 



 while retaining full ownership of correctness, security, and design quality of the generated
 



 output.
 



 • Write clean, testable, well\-instrumented code, participate in code reviews, and contribute
 



 to design and engineering documentation.
 



 • Collaborate with product managers, and fellow engineers to deliver high\-quality features.
 



 • Continuously learn and apply modern development practices and tools.
 



  





**Skills and Qualifications:** 




  





**•** 
 B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science, IT
 



 • Minimum 3 years of hands\-on backend engineering, with production\-level proficiency in Go and the
 



 ability and appetite to work in Rust.
 



 • Demonstrable experience in the observability domain: metrics, logs, traces, agents, collectors,
 



 monitoring systems, or telemetry pipelines.
 



 • Working knowledge of cloud and distributed systems — containers, Kubernetes, service\-to\-service
 



 communication, and the standard distributed failure modes (partial failure, backpressure, retries,
 



 idempotency).
 



 • Strong debugging and production problem\-solving ability using profilers, tracing, logs, and metrics.
 



 • Experience with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus or similar observability infrastructure.
 



 • Strong reasoning and first\-principles problem\-solving — the ability to break down an unfamiliar
 



 problem, form a hypothesis, and test it, rather than pattern\-matching to a previous solution.
 



 • Adaptive mindset — comfortable with changing priorities, evolving requirements, and switching
 



 between languages, platforms, and modules.
 



 • AI\-ready working style — treats AI tooling as leverage, prompts and reviews critically, and
 



 understands where generated code needs to be challenged.
 



 • A strong reading and self\-learning habit — follows source code, specifications, and engineering
 



 blogs, and can bring what they read back into the product.
 



 • Working comfort with statistical concepts as applied to time\-series (distributions, seasonality,
 



 percentiles, drift) and the ability to implement a detection algorithm from a specification or paper.
 



 • Ownership and accountability — takes a module from design through production support, raises
 



 risks early, and does not treat a handoff as the end of responsibility

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Delivery \& stakeholder ownership — Own end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-funded projects across multiple concurrent engagements. Run the daily cadence (standups, sprint reviews, hand\-offs) and act as the primary engineering point of contact for Product and Project Management on requirements, estimation, capacity planning, project tracking, CR workflows, and risk. Surface schedule and scope of risk early with credible mitigations, and provide honest, timely status to Client Services, Sales, Platform, Release Engineering, and senior leadership.
* Hands\-on technical leadership \& design — Stay close to one or more components across the TT platform (Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, trading UI). Author tech design documents for non\-trivial customer\-funded features and review designs produced by the team — ensuring correctness, performance, blast radius on shared components, rollout / rollback, observability, and long\-term supportability.  Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
   

  

****Essential Skills \& Experience****
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience), with 10 to 12 years of software engineering experience and 2\+ years managing a mid\-sized engineering team, including line management of engineers.
* Expert\-level hands\-on proficiency in modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11 through C\+\+20\) — able to review and write production\-grade code, and to lead deep technical discussions on architecture, multithreading, concurrency, and performance.
* Deep experience delivering software for electronic trading, capital markets, or other high\-performance, mission\-critical, low\-latency systems, with strong working knowledge of trading\-system fundamentals: order lifecycle, exchange gateways, FIX / exchange protocols, market data, price generation, and risk checks.
* Proven track record delivering complex, customer\-committed software projects in an Agile environment — working closely with Product and Project Management on estimation, planning, and CR workflows — and managing multiple concurrent engagements with changing priorities, aggressive timelines, and frequent context switching, while still meeting commitments.
* Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants and/or agentic developer tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalents) in real delivery — with a clear point of view on where they add leverage, where they don’t, and how to keep quality, security, and IP under control.

* Demonstrated success as a people manager — growing engineers and SQEs, hiring, calibrating, and handling difficult conversations — with excellent communication and stakeholder\-management skills across engineering, Product, Project Management, Client Services, and customers.


****Desirable Skills \& Experience****
* Prior experience leading customer\-funded, professional services, or bespoke\-delivery engineering teams in a financial\-technology context, ideally on a major OMS/EMS/trading platform with exposure to Order Routing, Market Data, Risk, FIX services, or trading UI.
* Familiarity with major exchange connectivity stacks (CME, ICE, Eurex, LSE, NSE, etc.) and with vendor certification / conformance testing, plus experience with formal CR / change\-management workflows in a regulated financial environment (Jira / Confluence for delivery tracking and design documentation).
* Working knowledge of Python for tooling, automation, and test scaffolding; familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, containerisation, and cloud technologies as applied to trading\-system delivery; background in kernel\-bypass / low\-latency networking (Solarflare, Onload) or lock\-free data structures.
* Track record of driving measurable productivity gains through AI adoption in an engineering team — e.g., accelerating design, code generation, code review, test coverage, or production triage — including establishing guardrails, prompts/skills libraries, and adoption metrics.


**Benefits**
**Compensation:**
***Competitive Benefits \& Perks in India***
*We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.*
* Health \& Financial Security:
+ Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage

* Time Off \& Flexibility:
+ Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture.

* Our Culture:
+ Forward\-thinking, culture\-based organization with collaborative teams that promote diversity and inclusion.

**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




 Script Assist is hiring a Full\-Stack Engineer with strong production experience in Node.js, TypeScript and React to build and evolve a complex multi\-tenant B2B SaaS platform used by UK clinics, pharmacies and operational teams.
 



 We are looking for engineers with approximately 3–5 years of professional experience who have worked inside a real shared SaaS product — not just simple CRUD applications or separate bespoke projects for individual clients.
 



 This is an AI\-first engineering environment. We expect engineers to use modern AI coding agents throughout the development lifecycle — from understanding unfamiliar code and planning changes to implementation, testing, debugging and reviewing results.
 



 AI should accelerate your work, while you remain responsible for ensuring that the software is correct, safe and maintainable.
 



**ABOUT SCRIPT ASSIST** 




 Script Assist is a UK healthcare technology company building software and operational infrastructure for complex private clinical and pharmacy services.
 



 Our platform:
 



 • Supports tens of thousands of recurring subscriptions each month alongside high\-volume clinical and pharmacy workflows.
 



 • Supports multiple medications, treatment pathways, clinics, pharmacies, prescribers, patients and operational teams within one shared platform.
 



 • Covers prescribing, patient onboarding, medication workflows, dispensing, inventory, subscriptions, payments, fulfilment, communications, reporting, permissions and external integrations.
 



 • Supports different organisational configurations and workflows while keeping the underlying product reliable, secure and maintainable.
 



 This is not a prototype or a simple dashboard product. Features interact with permissions, tenant configuration, existing workflows, integrations and production data.
 



 Healthcare experience is not required. Experience building genuinely complex software is.
 



**WHAT YOU WILL BUILD** 




 • Backend services and business logic using Node.js, NestJS and TypeScript.
 



 • React and TypeScript interfaces used by real operational teams.
 



 • Multi\-tenant features with correct tenant isolation and tenant\-specific configuration.
 



 • Stateful workflows involving multiple stages, roles, permissions and exception paths.
 



 • REST APIs, third\-party integrations, webhooks and asynchronous/background processing.
 



 • Reliable product behaviour around retries, validation, edge cases and partial failures.
 



 • Features across subscriptions, payments, pharmacy operations, inventory, fulfilment and clinical workflows.
 



 • Automated tests and observability that make production changes safer.
 



**MULTI\-TENANT SAAS EXPERIENCE** 




 Multi\-tenant SaaS experience is a core requirement for this role.
 



 We are looking for candidates who have actually developed a production product used by multiple customer organisations.
 



 You should have experience with:
 



 • A shared product and codebase used by multiple tenants/customers.
 



 • Tenant\-aware data access or isolation.
 



 • Different permissions, roles, configurations or feature access between tenants.
 



 • Customer\-specific behaviour without creating a completely separate product for every client.
 



 • Several interconnected modules, workflows or integrations.
 



 • Production releases where changes needed to remain compatible with existing customers.
 



 Important: Working on multiple separate client projects does not automatically mean you have multi\-tenant SaaS experience. We will ask you to explain how tenancy worked in the product you built.
 



**AI\-FIRST ENGINEERING** 




 We are looking for engineers whose development workflow has materially changed because of AI.
 



 AI should be a regular implementation tool, not something used only occasionally to explain an error.
 



 You will use AI to:
 



 • Understand – Inspect unfamiliar modules, trace code paths and understand existing patterns.
 



 • Plan – Break requirements into implementation steps, identify dependencies and consider edge cases.
 



 • Implement – Generate substantial implementation work rather than manually typing routine code.
 



 • Test – Create and extend unit, integration and edge\-case test coverage.
 



 • Debug – Analyse errors, logs, failing tests and unfamiliar execution paths.
 



 • Verify – Review diffs, run tests and validate behaviour yourself.
 



 AI output is never accepted blindly. You remain accountable for the quality, correctness and maintainability of your work.
 



**WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** 




 • 3–5 years of professional software engineering experience.
 



 • 2\+ years of hands\-on production Node.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production React / React.js development.
 



 • 2\+ years of production TypeScript development.
 



 • Real experience building a multi\-tenant SaaS product.
 



 • Strong understanding of backend business logic, APIs, databases and production debugging.
 



 • Experience owning features end\-to\-end rather than only implementing small isolated tickets.
 



 • Clear written and spoken English.
 



 • Strong AI\-assisted engineering experience across planning, implementation, testing and debugging.
 



**NICE TO HAVE** 




 • NestJS, Express or Fastify.
 



 • PostgreSQL, MongoDB or another production database.
 



 • Redis, queues, background jobs or event\-driven processing.
 



 • REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and third\-party integrations.
 



 • Docker, CI/CD and cloud environments.
 



 • RBAC, permissions, feature flags and tenant configuration.
 



 • Testing, logging, monitoring and production incident investigation.
 



 We do not require experience with one particular cloud, database or queue technology. We care more about the quality and complexity of the systems you have actually built.
 



**WHY JOIN SCRIPT ASSIST?** 




 • Build on a live multi\-tenant SaaS platform where your work reaches real customers quickly.
 



 • Work across backend and frontend rather than being confined to one narrow subsystem.
 



 • Take meaningful end\-to\-end ownership of features and workflows.
 



 • Work in an AI\-first engineering environment focused on leverage and delivery quality.
 



 • Solve complex operational problems involving integrations, state, permissions and customer variation.
 



 • Join a growing international product team with opportunities to take on greater ownership as the platform scales.
 



 If you have built and shipped complex, production\-grade multi\-tenant SaaS products using Node.js, TypeScript and React, we'd love to hear from you.
